title: Supplement Ceilings and Appeal Allowances by Keyturn Shield Host Plan
content:
Where further cost is found after a loss has been valued, and where a refusal is to be answered, the Keyturn Host Protection Plan publishes the periods and ceilings plan by plan.

| Plan | Supplement window, calendar days | Supplement ceiling, percent of the original appraisal | Appeal window, calendar days | Appeals allowed on one claim |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyturn Shield 90 Host Plan | 14 | 15 | 14 | 1 |
| Keyturn Shield 85 Host Plan | 21 | 20 | 21 | 1 |
| Keyturn Shield 80 Host Plan | 30 | 25 | 30 | 2 |
| Keyturn Shield 75 Host Plan | 45 | 30 | 45 | 2 |
| Keyturn Shield 70 Host Plan | 60 | 35 | 60 | 3 |
| Keyturn Shield 60 Host Plan | 90 | 40 | 90 | 3 |

### Condition, judgement, result

- Condition: the plan the enrolment is written on.
- Judgement: that plan's published supplement window and supplement ceiling, and its published appeal window and number of appeals.
- Result: on the Keyturn Shield 90 Host Plan, a supplement window of 14 calendar days and a ceiling of 15 percent of the original appraisal, an appeal window of 14 calendar days and 1 appeal on one claim; on the Keyturn Shield 60 Host Plan, 90 calendar days and 40 percent, 90 calendar days and 3 appeals.

### Note on the two windows

The supplement window and the appeal window happen to carry the same number of calendar days on every plan in the ladder, but they are separately published figures and are read from their own columns.
